posts.hook: Posting daily but still low bookings?
posts.caption:
Posting every day and getting few enquiries is frustrating. The issue often isn’t frequency — it’s how your studio appears to new clients in the first 3–5 seconds.

Quick diagnostic: check your profile headline, booking CTA and top three feed images. If any feel vague or busy, you’re losing attention and enquiries.

posts.objective: Teach a practical visibility improvement studio owners can implement
posts.topic: Optimising your profile headline and booking CTA
posts.hook: Your headline should convert the scroll into a message.
posts.caption:
Most potential clients decide in under five seconds. Make your profile headline a clear promise: who you serve, your style, and how to book.

Practical steps: 1) Replace vague phrases with your specialty (e.g. Colour realism | Bespoke portraits). 2) Add a one-line booking CTA with method (e.g. Book: link / DM / phone). 3) Pin a recent portfolio post that demonstrates your core work.

Want us to evaluate your profile and suggest exact changes? Reply to this post or email contact@getinkcare.co.uk to discuss the 72-Hour Studio Visibility Fix.
